name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
oracle_text: When this creature enters, each opponent loses X life, where X is your devotion to black. You gain life equal to the life lost this way. (Each {B} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to black.)
blocked_sentences: You gain life equal to the life lost this way.

needs.what: a way for a later effect in the same resolution to read the life ACTUALLY lost by a preceding lose_life (after replacements such as replace_life_loss doubling it, or lock_life_total reducing it to 0), summed over every player it hit -- e.g. `as` on the lose_life op binding that total as an int, readable through the existing `binding` value leaf by gain_life
needs.why_existing_wont_do: primitives.lose_life already returns what was actually lost, but op_lose_life discards the return value and takes only amount/player, so nothing can read it. Re-evaluating the amount in gain_life (the Malakir Bloodwitch pattern) gains X even when a Bloodletter-style replace_life_loss doubled the loss to 2X or a lock_life_total made it 0; life_lost_this_turn is a per-turn ledger total, not this effect's loss, and life_of cannot be captured before the loss because no op binds a number. Devotion itself is expressible as {"mana_symbols": {"of": "B", "objects": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you"}}}; only the second sentence is blocked
